fields.name: MapToPg*Attribute property-mapping family
fields.contract: A consumer annotates a model property with one MapToPg*Attribute variant and supplies a parameter name. The selected variant associates that property with its PostgreSQL target type, accepts only the CLR property types defined by the family matrix, and participates in input-parameter creation, output-parameter readback, and row-to-property readback. Every variant provides a parameter-name constructor and an overload that additionally records whether the mapping is required; Varchar, Char, Bytea, Numeric, and Array additionally require their variant-specific sizing, precision/scale, or element-type configuration.
